field_plane: tau=0.1; native reader planes 5,6,7 times sqrt(4 pi) -> bx,bz,by in gauss
quiet_reference: mean first-frame outgoing intensity where total field <100 G; no per-frame normalization
limitations: Gray disk-center radiation with a thermal optical-band correction, not local line-by-line spectral synthesis
Quiet-star limb law is used for active region; Wilson depression and directional facular hot-wall contrast are not newly solved
192 km grid cannot resolve the finest penumbral filaments
Patch is blended into independently simulated Bifrost background; not a globally coupled MHD solution
One 40:1 clock, separate source epochs, fixed 15x magnification; no fabricated plasma advection
